name: Twilio Core
description: Send text messages and place voice calls through Twilio.

fields.name: fromPhone
fields.description: The phone number that text messages are sent from. Set either this or a messaging service SID.

fields.name: messagingServiceSid
fields.description: The Twilio messaging service SID to send text messages through. Set either this or a from phone number.

fields.name: fromPhoneVoice
fields.description: The phone number that voice calls are placed from.

fields.name: authToken
fields.description: The Twilio auth token. Set either this or an API key and secret pair.

fields.name: apiKey
fields.description: The Twilio API key. Set together with an API secret instead of an auth token.

fields.name: apiSecret
fields.description: The Twilio API secret. Set together with an API key instead of an auth token.
